title: Keep API semantics intact when the transport fails
description: Inject a retry, compatibility, or reconnect incident and change operation identity, deadlines, schema evolution, and resume behavior. Protocol selection does not define the business outcome by itself.

incidents.label: Response lost after commit
incidents.detail: The server commits the command, but the client times out before receiving the response and retries.

incidents.label: Breaking schema rollout
incidents.detail: A producer removes or changes required meaning while older consumers are still active.

incidents.label: Client reconnects after a gap
incidents.detail: A long-lived stream disconnects while retained events continue to advance.
